name: Orient Tradelink Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Orient Trade link Ltd sells spiritual books
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is in production and marketing of Movies, Animated Movies, Television Serials, Song Albums, running shows on TV and Radio and is running a FMCG business under brand name Krishna Sai. Company has offline and online Sales and Marketing rights of Inventory of Audio-Visual content in Mantras and Mythology genre

pros: Stock is trading at 1.10 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 5.00% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.28% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.99 Cr.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -15.4%
